title: 7 Strange Phenomena Found in Space | Scientists Still Can’t Fully Explain Them
description:
Space is far stranger than it first appears.

In this video, we explore seven unusual phenomena found in space, including strange patterns on Mars, blue Martian sunsets, the silence of outer space, black holes wandering outside galaxies, unusually large moons, a possible dark matter signal, and Saturn’s newly observed ten-sided atmospheric pattern.

The more we learn about the universe, the more mysteries it seems to create.
pinnedComment:
Which of these seven space phenomena surprised you the most?
For me, Saturn’s decagon and the single dark matter signal are hard to forget.
